name: fll-bioglow-simulator
description: Browser simulator for the FIRST LEGO League Challenge 2026-27 BioGlow robot game, with SPIKE Prime Word Blocks import/export.

scripts.test:firebase: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,database --project demo-bioglow "BIOGLOW_EMULATOR_TEST=1 node --test test-firebase/shared-library.test.mjs"
scripts.test:admin: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.admin-qa.json --only auth,database --project demo-bioglow-admin "BIOGLOW_ADMIN_EMULATOR_TEST=1 node --test test-firebase/admin-library.test.mjs"
